routes.note: Ubicloud's own hosted runner, started through the Ubicloud GitHub App. Enabled in the up-lab/benchmark fork for one explicit 4-vCPU/16-GB baseline job. Label ubicloud-standard-4-ubuntu-2404 and image ubuntu-24.04 match the GitHub-hosted baseline OS and size; Ubicloud documents Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04 runner images. The App (167560338) is installed for all repositories and unsuspended, and the fork has admin push, but that does not prove first-job admission: the normal job is the admission test. premiumCpu and transparentCache remain null (unknown) until recorded from the account or job; do not force account settings. Published standard 4-vCPU rate is $0.0025/minute and premium is $0.004/minute, so 15 minutes estimates $0.0375 or $0.06 of machine time. That is informational, not an observed charge or a hard billing cutoff. The actual CPU fingerprint is required before interpreting results.
